items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: Yeah, I knew Paul very well.

ctx.x: Oh, I was gonna ask one of the questions about, um, if there are many more people from New Orleans out here that you can think of, like this Paul DeGroix, did you know him?
Yeah, I knew Paul very well. His brother Johnny's got a, they say, got a very fine band on there.

items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: I was up to see Paul, the mother, Mrs. Detroit.

ctx.x: And I remember when Johnny was playing in the scene of the old, which he was with a little pair of white pants on in front of the big band at the lake. Yeah. Yeah, I remember that. And, uh, I was up to see Paul, the mother, Mrs. Detroit. But Paul gets all the big French up with the big carnival balls now. Yeah. I mean, Johnny does.
